lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Eritrea through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset contains approximately 68.3 thousand mapped buildings with structural attributes (levels, materials, address information) derived from volunteer contributions, with coverage estimated at 19% of total buildings based on AI-assisted validation.
